svg.title: Union-Find parent array after each union
svg.desc: parent goes from 0..5 to [0,0,0,0,4,4]. Amber marks the entry each union set; the last union returns False and path compression rewrites only parent[3] (cyan).
svg.text: union(1,2): sizes tie at 2, so root 2 goes under root 0
union(0,3): find(3) climbs 3 → 2 → 0, then sets parent[3] = 0
